model: Verifier replacement is governance-only, rejects zero/non-contract targets, and transfers proof authority atomically to the newly configured verifier without altering adapter replay, route or asset state.
invariants: only governance may rotate a verifier
successful rotation updates the verifier authority immediately
old verifier output is no longer authoritative after rotation
new verifier output is authoritative after rotation
replay state remains owned by the adapter across verifier rotation
asset and route bindings survive verifier rotation unchanged
qualification_tests: unauthorized verifier rotation rejected on Ethereum and Solana adapters
zero-address and EOA-like verifier rotation rejected
Ethereum proof authority transfers from old verifier to new verifier
Solana proof authority transfers from old verifier to new verifier
